programmes.t: On the Case: Trail of Tears
programmes.d: A young woman's mysterious murder sends detectives on a heartbreaking search for the truth.

programmes.t: On the Case: That's Him!
programmes.d: September 17th, 1988. It was a warm California night and 58-yr-old Sal Ruscitti was enjoying some quiet time at home. Then the successful car salesman heard a knock on his front door. Seconds later the front room of the home erupted in chaos

programmes.t: On the Case: Nine Days of Terror
programmes.d: When a young college student disappears out of a mall parking lot, police find themselves in a race against time to find her before it is too late.

programmes.t: On the Case: Darkness After Dawn
programmes.d: After a newlywed is found murdered in her bedroom, a search is launched for the killer that will last for three decades.

programmes.t: On the Case: The River's Edge
programmes.d: When seventeen year old high school student Stacey Fairchild disappears from a mall parking lot in Lancaster Ohio, police wonder if she ran away, was kidnapped for ransom or the victim of senseless murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Storm of Rage
programmes.d: A Beautiful young mother vanishes just hours before the deadliest hurricane in Texas history. The investigation forces her loved ones to weather a storm and then survive a tempest.

programmes.t: On the Case: The Disappearance of Sarah Stern
programmes.d: A car is discovered abandoned in the middle of a New Jersey bridge, with the keys inside and no driver in sight. Detectives look at three possibilities. Sarah Stern either ran way, jumped off the bridge, or was the victim of foul play.

programmes.t: On the Case: Seven Minutes of Terror
programmes.d: It's two days before Christmas when two men burst into Michael Brinkman's home demanding money. Seven minutes later, the robbers are gone, Brinkman is dead from a gunshot wound to the chest, and some strange but critical evidence has been left behind.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Murder at Loose Chippings
programmes.d: After a wealthy couple is found dead in their stately Virginia home, investigators are taken on a wild journey around the globe before they uncover the shocking truth.

programmes.t: On the Case: Veil of Suspicion
programmes.d: A beloved husband and father is found executed in front of his home.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Betrayal Concealed
programmes.d: A 17-year-old's shocking murder shatters the peace in a small town and destroys her family.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Brand New Dress
programmes.d: An argument among sisters over a new dress leads a young girl to leave her house to calm down. But when she never returns, the desperate search to find her begins.

programmes.t: On the Case: Mixed Signals
programmes.d: Cell phone records may help solve the disturbing murder of a popular teenager.

programmes.t: On the Case: Notes From a Killer
programmes.d: April 1st 1988. It was a cloudy afternoon when 8-year-old April Tinsley left home for a play date. Janet Tinsley never could have imagined that would be the last conversation she would ever have with her beloved daughter.

programmes.t: On the Case: Blood Money
programmes.d: After 21 years, DNA analysis of a blood-stained dollar bill helps to solve the murder of gas station clerk Bradley Perry.

programmes.t: On the Case: Web of Torment
programmes.d: The abduction of a young mother from a crowded hospital parking lot is the beginning of a terrifying mystery that will torment her loved ones for decades.

programmes.t: On the Case: Justice Never Quits
programmes.d: Mary-Jane Marquardt, mother and wife from Chippewa, Wisconsin, was found stabbed to death in her own home. With Mary-Jane's son also missing, the detectives couldn't help but wonder if his disappearance was connected to the murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: Gone in a Blink
programmes.d: A teenager waiting for her friends to give her a ride home from work suddenly disappears. When her friends arrive, they find terrifying evidence of her abduction.

programmes.t: On the Case: In Broad Daylight
programmes.d: A young mother is murdered in broad daylight with her toddler just a few feet away. Police have little to go on except the bizarre description eyewitnesses have given them of the brazen killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: When, Where, and Who?
programmes.d: A 15-year-old girl vanishes from her front porch, and police have only a few short hours to determine who saw her last, where she was going, and who would want her dead.

programmes.t: On the Case: Field of Nightmares
programmes.d: A young mother and son are found shot to death in a quiet Texas field. Would a mysterious bag left at the crime scene hold the key to catching their killer?

programmes.t: On the Case: Murder Ordained?
programmes.d: When a young minister's wife is found dead, it appears to be a tragic accident. But then, another member of the congregation is murdered. Police begin to wonder if its just a coincidence or a calculated plot.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Ray of Darkness
programmes.d: Police must connect two vicious murders in order to bring a single killer to justice.

programmes.t: On the Case: Pattern of Violence
programmes.d: A 22 year old real estate agent is discovered strangled to death inside a model home she was trying to sell.

programmes.t: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programmes.d: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Window to Murder
programmes.d: A valiant teenager's dying act helps police solve the mystery behind her murder

programmes.t: On the Case: Hidden by Fire
programmes.d: When firefighters respond to a raging house fire they discover the blaze was just the cover up for a vicious murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: Christina's Story
programmes.d: When a young girl vanishes while walking her dog on a military base, it marks the beginning of a missing persons case that would capture the hearts of the entire county.
